title: Not Quality, not worth the cheap price.or should I say the price I paid.
text: Not Quality, not worth the cheap price.or should I say the price I paid.. Cheap, I could not figure out why I got no coffee, you learn there is a handle inside which you have to turn for every cup. It is a bad design. Coffee does not taste well, it tastes like water. I used it for tea and it does make a good cup of tea. But I still have to turn inside a handle. It is not worth the money.
